entities.summary: Daniel Mark Nestor is a Canadian former professional tennis player. He was ranked as the world No. 1 in men's doubles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) for 108 weeks. Nestor won 95 ATP Tour-level doubles titles, including twelve majors, an Olympic gold medal at the 2000 Sydney Olympics, and four Tour Finals. Nestor was the first man to complete the Big Titles sweep in doubles, an achievement only matched by the Bryan brothers. He was part of the ATP Doubles Team of the Year in 2002 and 2004, and 2008.
